purpose: Review official Geneva cadastral channels and qualify bounded anonymous parcel geometry evidence.
assessment: The official SITG viewer/configuration and Canton of Geneva ArcGIS parcel layer were identified and queried anonymously. The exact transformed WUP point returned a safe parcel identity, and a bounded envelope returned three full parcel polygons. This is local public geometry evidence, not a citywide completeness claim.
